sehemu: Part III: Procedure, Powers and Privileges of Parliament
maudhui: (1) Parliament shall hold its meetings at the place where it is customary to hold such meetings or at any other place in the United Republic designated by the President for that purpose. (2) The first meeting of Parliament during its life shall commence on the day on which Parliament is summoned to meet, and every subsequent meeting shall commence on such day as Parliament itself may determine or as may be determined in accordance with the Standing Orders. (3) The President may summon a meeting of Parliament at any time.
